item.text: {"claim_count":72,"content_failure_reasons":["The statement that the Talos block was \"returned to Pemex\" materially misstates the extract: the president said Pemex was assigned operation of a shared reservoir after consultations because it held more petroleum and experience; he did not say Talos's block was returned.","The map omits the conference's substantive COVID-19 health-performance evidence—ten consecutive weeks of decline, 3% general-bed and 1% ventilator-bed occupancy, minimal mortality with some zero-death days, and the pediatric-vaccine delivery schedule—despite presenting itself as a map of the source's 5B.6 health evidence."],"content_usable":false,"material_omission":true,"material_omission_explanation":"The omitted COVID-19 indicators and vaccination figures are substantial, directly relevant evidence for the health-service/effectiveness questions under 5B.6, and potentially score-decisive when considered with the included IMSS-Bienestar figures. Other non-decisive omissions include numerous disaggregated security results, Michoacán-specific earthquake damage, and additional qualifications and figures concerning the health, military-support, Pemex, and Sonora discussions.","schema_version":"reader_content_audit_v1","source_id":"PREZ-005","supported_claim_count":71,"unsupported_claim_count":1,"usable_locator_count":71}
